title: Build reference runner with differential test suite
api_or_output: Ordinary solution build produces required BCL subprocess runner

acceptance.description: Add no-output ProjectReference to verified BclReference project so clean ordinary solution build produces the executable before differential protocol tests; do not add reference implementation to runtime package.

From cleaned generated outputs run normal Release solution build and MTP solution tests without prebuilding runner manually. Real protocol/subprocess tests pass and controlled infrastructure failure checks remain effective.
Verify preserved bootstrap/help/managed package behavior and actual package graph plus task validation at a full known implementation revision.

evidence.summary: Exact reference alone built BCL runner in Debug during Release solution build. Twelve actual runner-dependent protocol tests failed missing Release executable. Preserved as historical evidence; superseded by scoped configuration fix.

macOS arm64 SDK10.0.400: removed generated bin/obj from 12 actual solution/reference projects, proved runner absent, ordinary solution restore/Release build without manual runner build succeeded with 0 warnings/errors. BclReference Release executable and copied protocol assembly exist; native MTP XML confirms 51 protocol +3 smoke tests, 54 pass0 fail0 skip,0 product tests. All3 controlled smoke failures exit2. Preserved16 help/default invocations,3 unknown exits2, managed-only net10.0 package/API0, runtime assets graph empty libraries/targets/project refs, evaluated exact no-output build edge,101-task validation. MSBuild retains its default Debug configuration for the transitive protocol project and copies that assembly into runner output; all Release executable checks pass. No other-platform/native-engine/runtime-conformance/performance claim.
